decisions.reason: The existing message-595 MODIFY already captures that eligible Small Block tickets come from primary mints, including randomly allocated no-referral tickets. The exclusion of secondary sales concerns ticket issuance and does not require changing the separate sales-based draw cadence.

The existing message-595 MODIFY already includes randomly allocated no-referral primary-mint tickets in the eligible population and probability weighting. No additional VRF selection attribute requires modification.
